data.description: Home to top-notch attractions and world-class hotels, Palm Jumeirah symbolizes the "Dubai style of Island living."

data.answer:
Palm Jumeirah is considered one of Dubai's most prestigious and sought-after addresses, offering an exclusive and luxurious living experience. It attracts a mix of local and international residents, including high-net-worth individuals and celebrities, seeking a unique and opulent lifestyle in one of Dubai's most iconic developments.

Palm Jumeirah is home to some of Dubai's most prestigious hotels and resorts, including the iconic Atlantis, The Palm. These establishments offer world-class amenities, fine dining, and luxury accommodations.

Renowned for its high-end residential and commercial developments, the island offers diverse housing options, including opulent villas, townhouses, and luxurious apartments, many of which boast breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai's skyline.

The community is considered a prime location for real estate investment, offering the potential for capital appreciation. Residents benefit from high-quality amenities, including private beaches, fitness centers, and upscale dining experiences.

Overall, Palm Jumeirah's property market reflects a unique blend of luxury, convenience, and a vibrant lifestyle, making it an attractive destination for those seeking an exclusive living experience in Dubai.

Most Popular Properties in Palm Jumeirah Dubai

Palm Jumeirah is home to numerous apartment buildings and villa complexes. Topping the popularity charts is Shoreline Apartments, a development consisting of 20 mid-rise buildings showcasing 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses. Managed by Nakheel Properties, this project comprises over 2,000 residential units and offers various shared amenities, including covered parking, an infinity pool, and a fitness center.

Nestled in the core of Palm Jumeirah, the Palm Tower rises majestically with 52 stories, housing residences and captivating attractions. Positioned on floors 19 to 47, The Palm Tower comprises 432 fully furnished apartments, providing sweeping views of the island, water, and skyline. The residences encompass a variety of opulent options, including studios to 3-bedroom apartments.

Golden Mile is another popular project located on the western trunk. It is a complex of inter-connected 11-story buildings. You can find many Golden Mile Palm Jumeirah for sale apartments to choose from.

Among the most popular properties in the area is also Marina Residence. A complex of six buildings, Marina Residence features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, 4-bedroom penthouses, and 5-bedroom townhouses.

There are also various popular villa communities in the area. The list includes Garden Homes Palm Jumeirah, an exclusive villa complex offering residences with 4 to 7 bedrooms. These villas feature private beach access, a pool, and parking facilities.

The Signature Villas in Palm Jumeirah is also popular among buyers and tenants. This residence more closely resembles a castle than a villa. Upon entry, a double-height space welcomes you, leading through the hallway to the dining area and extending into the garden. These homes offer ample outdoor space, including a landscaped garden with a seating area and pergola, a private beach, and a roof terrace overlooking Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab, and the Marina Skyline.

Balqis Residence on Palm Jumeirah is a distinguished residential development known for its luxurious offerings. This exclusive property features a range of upscale residences, from apartments to villas, offering residents a premium living experience.

Off-Plan Projects in Palm Jumeirah Dubai

Off-plan properties in Palm Jumeirah often come with attractive payment plans and the potential for appreciation in value as the development progresses. Investors and homebuyers can choose from various residences like apartments, villas, or townhouses. Here are some upcoming properties in Palm Jumeirah from the list.

Como Residences

Como Residences by Nakheel features a remarkable selection of 2- to 6-bedroom apartments and 7-bedroom duplexes with unmatched grandeur and luxury. The tower, consisting of 75 levels, offers paddle and tennis courts, a private sandy beach, an infinity pool and a sundeck.

SLS Residences

SLS Residences by Roya has 113 carefully designed units, including 2 and 3-bedroom simplexes, 3 and 4-bedroom duplexes, and penthouses. The ground floor offers 13 exclusive residences with private gardens for those seeking privacy.

Armani Beach Residences

Armani Beach Residences, developed by Arada, is a luxurious branded residence born from the collaboration of Japanese architect Tadao Ando and fashion icon Giorgio Armani. Consisting of 53 boutique residences, the project presents an array of 2 to 5-bedroom apartments, penthouses, and two exclusive top-floor presidential suites featuring rooftop access.

Palm Beach Tower 3

Following the successful sales of Palm Beach Towers 1 and 2, Nakheel has unveiled Palm Beach Towers 3. Positioned with direct access to the beach, these expansive 1 to 3-bedroom apartments present unparalleled luxury and breathtaking views. These residences are officially licensed as vacation homes, available for short-term rentals, providing an exceptional living experience by the sea.

Six Senses Branded Residences

Gracefully situated on the West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah, Six Senses Branded Residences The Palm is a Select Group project. It showcases a collection of villas and penthouses. Residents and guests can enjoy various wellness and lifestyle amenities, including a massage circuit pool, squash court, wellness circuit, Six Senses Spa, communal working space, and meeting rooms.

AVA at Palm Jumeirah

AVA at Palm Jumeirah is developed by Omniyat. The luxury property offers 17 exclusive units, each spanning the entire floor. The apartments provide residents with a private pool and terraces with breathtaking views of the Palm and Dubai’s stunning skyline.

One Palm Omniyat

One Palm Omniyat consists of 3 and 4-bedroom beachfront apartments and penthouses offering 360-degree views of the Gulf. These residences provide outdoor spaces, private beach access, an outdoor pool, a private cinema and more.

Ocean House

The project has a floor plan consisting of 2 to 4-bedroom apartments and 5 to 6-BHK penthouses. Situated on the northeastern side of Palm Jumeirah, the modern contemporary Ocean House offers its residents hotel-like amenities.

Palace Beach Residence

Located on the iconic Emaar Beachfront, Palace Beach Residence is an apartment complex. The project comprises units available in 1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations. The beachfront residences offer stunning vistas of the water.  The facilities include a BBQ area, beach access, spa, fitness center, and running track.

One Crescent

The super-luxury tower has 9 floors and boasts a luxury lifestyle while staying close to nature. One Crescent features 3 to 6-BHK penthouses providing a private elevator, exclusive membership to the golf course and many other amenities.

Ellington Beach House

Ellington Beach House comprises 1- to 4-bedroom units featuring super-yacht style architecture. It provides sweeping panoramic city vistas while encapsulating the essence and sophistication reminiscent of an exclusive private club.

Renting a Property in Palm Jumeirah 

Various options are available to rent an apartment in Palm Jumeirah Dubai. Check out the starting prices for properties for rent in Palm Jumeirah.

  • Studio Palm Jumeirah apartments for rent are available for AED 77.9k per annum.
  • 1-BHK Palm Jumeirah rental apartment costs a minimum of AED 130k.
  • For a 2-bedroom apartment for rent in Palm Jumeirah, you might have to pay AED 220k per year.
  • A 3-bedroom apartment for rent in Palm Jumeirah Dubai is available for AED 270k.

Villas for rent in Palm Jumeirah Dubai come with fantastic amenities. A range of rental properties is available, including furnished villas in Palm Jumeirah, brand-new units, independent houses with private gardens and pools and luxury villas for rent. You can choose from the best rental properties available according to your needs and preferences.

  • 3-bed Palm Jumeirah villas for rent are priced at AED 500k minimum.
  • For 4-BHK villas for rent in Palm Jumeirah Dubai, you would pay around AED 599k annually.
  • For AED 700k, you can get a 5-bedroom villa for rent in Palm Jumeirah.

Buying a Property in Palm Jumeirah Area

Looking for a Palm Jumeirah property for sale? Here are the apartment types available for sale in Dubai Palm Jumeirah

  • You can purchase a studio in Palm Jumeirah for AED 1.4M
  • A 1-bedroom apartment for sale in Palm Jumeirah is available for AED 2.6M.
  • For 2-bed apartments for sale in Palm Jumeirah, the price is around Dubai 3M
  • Palm Jumeirah apartments for sale with 3 bedrooms start from AED 5.4M.

The Palm Jumeirah villas for sale provide residents with upscale facilities, from private beach access to wellness centers. If you are looking for a luxury home right in the heart of the palm, here are your options:

  • 3-bedroom Palm Jumeirah houses for sale are available for AED 6.7M.
  • Dubai Palm Jumeirah Villa for sale with 4 bedrooms costs about AED 10M.
  • Dubai properties for sale in Palm Jumeirah with 5 bedrooms are available for AED 19M.
  • For a 6-bedroom villa for sale in Palm Jumeirah, you might have to pay AED 19.8M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Palm Jumeirah?

data.answer:
Life in Palm Jumeirah is a luxurious and exclusive experience characterized by opulent residences, upscale amenities, and a vibrant beachfront lifestyle. The island's exclusive communities, nestled in various fronds, provide residents with privacy and security, attracting a diverse mix of population. The presence of world-class hotels, including the iconic Atlantis The Palm, adds to the allure, offering top-notch dining, entertainment, and leisure options.

Residents can enjoy various recreational activities, from water sports to jogging along the boardwalk and relaxing on pristine beaches. The diverse culinary scene, high-end shopping at Nakheel Mall, and community events contribute to a rich and dynamic social life. With excellent transportation connections to the mainland and spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf and the Dubai skyline, life on Palm Jumeirah reflects Dubai's cosmopolitan nature, offering a global lifestyle amid a backdrop of luxury and cultural diversity.

Public Transportation in Palm Jumeirah 

You can easily access the area through public transportation in Dubai Palm Jumeirah. A widely utilized public transportation option in Palm Jumeirah Dubai is the Palm Monorail, serving as a favored mode of travel for visitors and tourists.

This monorail covers a 5.5 km route, allowing visitors and residents to explore the neighborhood's landmarks. It operates through four stations: the Palm Gateway Station, Al Ittihad Park Station, Nakheel Mall Station, and Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark Station. In addition to the monorail, alternative modes of public transportation in the area encompass the tram and taxi services.

Supermarkets in Palm Jumeirah Area

Numerous supermarkets are strategically located along the Trunk of Palm Jumeirah, providing convenient access for residents. Allday Fresh Supermarket, Choithrams, Cherry Express Minimart, and Spinneys are among these. Union Coop, one of the premier supermarkets in Palm Jumeirah, offers a diverse selection of daily essentials. Additionally, residents can shop for groceries at Waitrose and Quick Buy Supermarket.

Shopping Malls in Palm Jumeirah 

Palm Jumeirah is a shopper's haven, housing two glamorous shopping destinations: Golden Mile Galleria and Nakheel Mall. The iconic Golden Mile Galleria spans an impressive 400,000 sq. ft. and features approximately 70 retail outlets showcasing renowned brands, diverse dining options, a fitness center, and more. Adjacent to Al Ittihad Park, it offers a comprehensive shopping and leisure experience.

Situated on the trunk, Nakheel Mall is Palm Jumeirah's latest retail hotspot, boasting over 300 retail outlets, a 15-screen cinema complex, and an array of dining facilities across five levels. This Palm Jumeirah Mall presents a fine dining plaza, while The View, a public observation deck linked with the Palm Tower, provides breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline and the Arabian Gulf.

Schools in Palm Jumeirah Dubai

There are several nurseries in Palm Jumeirah where you can send younger kids. Blossom Nursery in the area follows the EYFS British Curriculum for children aged 4 months to 6 years. It is a part of Babilou Education and is located on the mezzanine floor of Golden Mile Galleria Building 3. Other notable options include Redwood Montessori Nursery and Asya’s Nursery.

Although there are no schools inside the community, parents with school-going children do not have to worry as there are several options at easily accessible locations. GEMS Wellington International School and American School of Dubai are popular schools near Palm Jumeirah Dubai.

Situated adjacent to Dubai Knowledge Park, the waterfront community neighbors various educational institutions and universities, including Middlesex University, the University of Wollongong, and the American University of Dubai. Additionally, Palm Jumeirah hosts the Melodica Music Center, a school specializing in music and dance, in Nakheel Mall. This center provides individual or group lessons for children, adults, and professionals, offering diverse learning opportunities.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in Palm Jumeirah Area

The Abdul Rahman Siddik Mosque in Palm Jumeirah is one of Dubai's most exquisite mosques. With a distinguished design, the mosque includes a dome and an impressive 49-meter-high minaret featuring a facade adorned with layers of rough stones and patterned glass. Capable of accommodating 800 people, the mosque also provides a dedicated prayer area for women with a capacity for 200 females. To further facilitate congregational prayers, there is ample parking available for residents.

For those practicing other faiths, the Fellowship – A Christian Church in Dubai, is conveniently situated only 10 minutes from the Palm's entrance. Christian residents can also reach the Emirates Baptist Church International (EBCI) and the Evangelical Christian Church of Dubai in under 13 minutes, depending on their location on the island.

The Hindu Temple Dubai serves as the nearest temple, catering to the Hindu community in Palm Jumeirah. Buddhists residing in the area can access the Mahamevnawa Temple in approximately 20 minutes, providing diverse religious facilities for the community.

Clinics and Hospitals in Palm Jumeirah 

Several healthcare facilities in Palm Jumeirah include Dr. Joy Dental Clinic, Dubai London Clinic, and Al Das Medical Clinic. Emirates Hospitals & Clinic Palm Jumeirah is particularly esteemed for its outstanding healthcare services, ranking among the top clinics in Dubai.

For additional medical options, Al Zahra Hospital Dubai on Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) is reachable with a brief 10-minute drive from the Trunk. Likewise, the Canadian Medical Center is accessible under 15 minutes from Palm Jumeirah, offering residents diverse healthcare services.

Location & Nearby Areas

Along the Arabian Gulf, Palm Jumeirah offers a captivating view of Dubai's coastline and the iconic sail-shaped Burj Al Arab hotel. Positioned across Knowledge Village and Dubai Internet City, the community also shares proximity with the residential and leisure hotspot, Dubai Marina. Accessible within approximately 12 minutes by car through King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Street (D92), the central marina connects Palm Jumeirah to various districts, with Jumeirah Lake Towers on one side and Al Sufouh 1 on the other.

Moreover, residents enjoy convenient access to adjacent residential clusters, including the Emirates Living Communities such as The Greens, The Views Community Dubai, and The Meadows. The strategic location of Palm Jumeirah ensures a seamless connection to both coastal and inland neighborhoods, enhancing the overall accessibility and appeal of the community.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Palm Jumeirah

data.answer:
Palm Jumeirah offers many exciting activities and attractions for residents and visitors alike. The stunning beaches provide the perfect setting for relaxation and water activities, including swimming and water sports. The Palm Jumeirah Boardwalk is a popular spot for strolls and jogging, offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the Dubai skyline. The vibrant nightlife scene features high-end beach clubs and restaurants, making it an ideal destination for those seeking entertainment after sunset.

The Nakheel Mall, located on the palm's trunk, provides a premier shopping experience with a mix of luxury brands and dining options. Residents can also explore the iconic Atlantis, The Palm resort, which boasts an aquarium, water park, and various restaurants. Additionally, the Palm Jumeirah Monorail offers a unique and scenic mode of transportation, connecting different parts of the island. With its diverse array of attractions, Palm Jumeirah ensures that there is always something exciting to see or do for everyone.

Palm Jumeirah Restaurants and Bars

Palm Jumeirah boasts extensive dining options, offering diverse culinary delights worldwide. A few noteworthy establishments include Saffron Restaurant, Kaleidoscope Buffet, Seafire Steakhouse & Bar, and The Locale. For a taste of classic Italian cuisine, Cinque is an excellent choice. At the same time, Frevo at Fairmont The Palm specializes in Brazilian fare, and Miyabi Sushi & Bento caters to Japanese cravings. Other notable dining spots include the Great British Restaurant, Rock House Sliders, and many more.

Palm Jumeirah offers several pubs and bars for those seeking nightlife, such as 101 Dining Lounge and Marina and Bushman’s Restaurant and Bar. Additionally, the island is home to popular cafes like Arabiska Cafe, Boon Coffee Roasters, and Caffè Nero, providing residents and visitors with a vibrant and diverse culinary experience.

Beaches Near Palm Jumeirah 

Palm Jumeirah beaches are a prominent feature, integral to its allure. A defining aspect of the residences in this architectural marvel is its extraordinary beachfront living experience, with each villa along the fronds having its private beach.

Additionally, the island hosts renowned private beaches affiliated with luxury hotels and resorts. Notable examples include FIVE Palm Jumeirah, Sofitel The Palm, and One&Only Royal Mirage. Beyond sunbathing, residents and visitors can partake in various beach activities, including snorkeling and wildlife encounters at Aquaventure Waterpark. Palm Jumeirah truly offers a multifaceted coastal experience for all who indulge in its luxurious surroundings.

Hotels in Palm Jumeirah Area

This artificial island isn't just a residential haven but also an ideal tourist holiday destination. Numerous beachfront hotels and resorts grace the island, offering various amenities and entertainment facilities.

Let's explore some of the top luxurious hotels in Dubai, starting with Hotel Fairmont The Palm, situated on The Crescent, providing premium 5-star accommodation with private beach access. Adjacent to it is Dubai Marriott Harbour Hotel, offering a 4-star staycation option. Dukes The Palm, a 5-star hotel on the trunk, boasts waterfront suites, an indoor pool, a spa, and various dining options.

Atlantis The Palm, a renowned landmark, needs no introduction as one of Dubai's most visited tourist sites. Offering helicopter tours and family-favorite water park adventures, it remains a bustling resort throughout the year.

FIVE Palm Jumeirah Hotel is another 5-star gem featuring 470 luxurious rooms with city views and various facilities like restaurants, a fitness center, a spa, and a steam and sauna room. The private beach is a standout feature of this exquisite hotel.

The Palm Tower houses St. Regis Dubai – The Palm, further enhancing the island's reputation as a luxurious and sought-after destination.

Attractions and Landmarks near Palm Jumeirah

Palm Jumeirah is one of Dubai's and the world's most prominent landmarks. At the heart of this captivating community lies Atlantis The Palm, a luxury hotel positioned at the pinnacle of the Palm on the expansive Crescent. Atlantis transcends the concept of a mere hotel, evolving into the ultimate leisure destination in Palm Jumeirah. The site encompasses various leisure and entertainment facilities, including the Aquaventure Waterpark, which features Dolphin Bay and Sea Lion Point. The Lost Chambers Aquarium is a haven for exploring the unique marina life.

For those unafraid of heights, The View on The Palm, the island's highest point, is a must-visit destination in The Palm Tower. Residents also enjoy direct access to Nakheel Mall from The Palm Tower. Additional recreational activities on Palm Jumeirah include exhilarating rides on speedboats or kayaks around the island, providing panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

The island actively encourages outdoor activities through various means. Numerous parks enhance the surroundings, with the Boardwalk in the Palm Jumeirah Corniche area being a favored pedestrian zone. Offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea and a refreshing sea breeze, it is a popular spot for residents for a morning jog. Notable parks in the area include Al Ittihad Park, Palm Jumeirah Park, and Palm Island Dubai.

Adventure seekers can also have their adrenaline pumping as the area has a dropzone of Skydive Dubai. Embark on an exhilarating free-fall and parachute adventure with Skydive Dubai, a premier attraction that captivates both daring thrill-seekers and celebrities visiting the city.

Regarding fitness options, many residential developments boast their gyms, while Golden Mile Galleria hosts a Platinum Fitness First. For a unique fitness experience, Monty’s Rowing School & Club caters to those interested in rowing. Yogis can solace at Yoga La Vie Dubai, offering yoga classes and practices.

Beauty salons and spas are plentiful in Palm Jumeirah, including WOW Beauty Salon, Esthetic Sense, The Loft Fifth Avenue, and Toni & Guy. The Bridal Makeover provides specialized services for those planning their special day.

Palm Jumeirah is a stunning location and an exceptional community. However, being an island, the area is a little far from other areas of Dubai. Due to this, private transportation is often necessary, as public transport options on the Palm are limited compared to other parts of the city. Nonetheless, Palm Jumeirah remains one of Dubai's most attractive locations for those looking for an enviable upscale lifestyle.

Who is the owner of Palm Jumeirah?

Nakheel, the real estate company currently under government ownership in Dubai, is the developer behind the creation of Palm Jumeirah.

How was Palm Jumeirah built?

The construction of Palm Jumeirah involved extensive land reclamation and the use of advanced engineering techniques. It was built by the Dubai-based company Nakheel Properties and completed in 2006.

What are the main attractions in Palm Jumeirah?

Palm Jumeirah has various attractions, including the Atlantis The Palm resort, Aquaventure Waterpark, The Lost Chambers Aquarium, and the Palm Jumeirah Boardwalk. The island also features luxurious hotels, restaurants, and shopping destinations.

Is Palm Jumeirah a good place to live?

Palm Jumeirah is considered a desirable place for those seeking a luxurious and beachfront lifestyle. It offers high-end residences, stunning views, and a range of amenities. However, opinions on its suitability as a residential area may vary based on individual preferences.

How can I access Palm Jumeirah?

Palm Jumeirah is accessible by road, and the main entrance is through a monorail system. Cars, taxis, and public transportation can be used to reach the island. Additionally, there are boat and yacht access points.

Are there schools and healthcare facilities in Palm Jumeirah?

While Palm Jumeirah is primarily known for residential and leisure offerings, nearby educational institutions and healthcare facilities on the mainland provide services to the residents.

Can tourists visit Palm Jumeirah?

Tourists can visit Palm Jumeirah and explore its attractions, hotels, and beaches. Many guided tours and excursions are available to showcase the beauty and landmarks of the island.

data.content:
Palm Jumeirah is an artificial island shaped like a date palm tree located off the coast of Dubai. It is considered the Emirates' most luxurious district, home to iconic hotels and stunning resorts. The development is an engineering marvel and a symbol of Dubai's dedication to pushing the boundaries of urban architecture. 

Palm Jumeirah offers a variety of leisure and recreational activities, including sky diving, beaches, infinity pools, an observation deck, a waterpark, and numerous upmarket dining and retail options. Moreover, you can find many residential options, including villas, apartments, and townhouses. 

The area is well-connected with Dubai's public transportation network, roads, and tunnels. Exploring Palm Jumeirah by a yacht or a speedboat can be the most fun activity. There are various private touring companies offering boat trips to the beautiful area.

nodes.title: Maison Margiela Residence
nodes.about:
Maison Margiela Residence at Palm Jumeirah by Alta Real Estate Development marks the fashion house’s first branded residential project in Dubai real estate. Located on the prestigious island, this waterfront development offers panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, Burj Al Arab, and the Dubai skyline. 

The project includes a limited collection of 25 residences, featuring 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom units, as well as a 4-bedroom duplex, and one exclusive penthouse, La Maison Blanche. The penthouse spans 18,804 sq. ft. across two levels and offers five bedrooms, private terraces, a sculptural pool, a jacuzzi, and 360-degree sea and skyline views. 

Each home is designed with bespoke materials such as travertine, marmorino, and brushed metal, blending organic textures with refined finishes. Amenities include a private beach, gym, spa, screening room, art gallery, residents’ lounge, yoga studio, and curated concierge services, all reflecting Maison Margiela’s understated luxury and design philosophy.

Passo by Beyond Developments is not just a residence; it's a lifestyle. Set against a backdrop of uninterrupted sea and skyline views, the project redefines beachfront living.
